title: Investigation of the rotational spectrum of CD<SUB>3</SUB>OD and an astronomical search toward IRAS 16293-2422
question: Develop an accurate spectroscopic model of CD3OD in low-lying torsional states up to 1.1 THz and search for CD3OD toward the protostellar system IRAS 16293-2422 using ALMA PILS data.

what.value: 488 v_t = 0 and 182 v_t = 1 microwave transitions of CD3OD up to J_max = 25 and K_max = 14

evidence.quote: We started our analysis from the results of (cite: CD3OD_rot-K_2006), where the dataset, consisting of 488 $\varv_{\rm t} = 0$ and 182 $\varv_{\rm t} = 1$ microwave transitions, ranging up to $J_{\rm max} = 25$ and $K_{\rm max} = 14$
Finally, at an advanced stage of our analysis, the FIR data from (cite: CD3OD_rot_etc-IM_2021) were added to the fit.
The dipole moment function of (cite: MEKHTIEV1999171) was employed in our calculations

what.value: Permanent dipole moment components for CD3OD (mu_a = 0.867 D and mu_b = 1.430 D)

evidence.quote: replaced by appropriate ones for CD$_3$OD $\mu_a = 0.867$ D and $\mu_b = 1.430$ D taken from (cite: MUKHOPADHYAY19981307).

what.value: CH3OH main isotopolog column density constrained by CH3^18OH

evidence.quote: The quoted column density would correspond to an CD$_3$OD abundance of 0.02% relative to the main isotopolog CH$_3$OH (the column density of that constrained by observations of optically thin transitions of CH$_3^{18}$OH).

recipe.goal: Fit laboratory and literature torsion-rotation spectra of CD3OD using a RAM Hamiltonian
recipe.method: Bootstrap least-squares fitting of 4337 FIR and 10001 microwave line frequencies using the rho-axis-method (RAM) Hamiltonian with a two-step diagonalization procedure.
key_parameters: 117 Hamiltonian parameters; 31 torsional basis functions at first step, 11 at second step; J_max = 51

recipe.goal: Generate astronomical line list and partition function for CD3OD
recipe.method: Calculate transition frequencies, uncertainties, lower state energies, and transition strengths up to 1.33 THz from the best-fit RAM Hamiltonian, and compute torsion-rotation partition function via direct summation.
key_parameters: v_t <= 1, J <= 55, |K_a| <= 25, frequency <= 1.33 THz, uncertainty < 0.1 MHz; partition function up to J = 90 and n_vt = 11
assumptions: Permanent dipole moment components mu_a = 0.867 D and mu_b = 1.430 D

recipe.goal: Search for CD3OD and derive upper column density limit in IRAS 16293-2422 B
recipe.method: Calculate LTE synthetic spectra and compare the 16 strongest predicted lines of CD3OD against the ALMA PILS spectrum at the offset position near IRAS 16293-2422 B.
key_parameters: v_LSR = 2.6 km s^-1, FWHM = 1 km s^-1, T_ex = 225 K
assumptions: Local thermodynamical equilibrium (LTE), T = 225 K, v_LSR = 2.6 km s^-1, FWHM = 1 km s^-1

answer_key.quantity: Weighted RMS deviation of best-fit RAM Hamiltonian model

evidence.quote: A Hamiltonian model consisting of 117 parameters provided a fit with a weighted root mean square (RMS) deviation of 0.71 which was selected as our "best fit" for this paper.

answer_key.quantity: CD3OD upper column density limit toward IRAS 16293-2422 B

evidence.quote: the column density is taken to be the maximum possible without overproducing lines compared to the RMS noise level of the data with a value of 2$\times 10^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$.
The upper column density limit of 2$\times 10^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ for CD$_3$OD was derived based on the assumption of an excitation temperature of 225 K
The quoted column density would correspond to an CD$_3$OD abundance of 0.02% relative to the main isotopolog CH$_3$OH
Comparison with the CH$_3$OH main isotopolog (for which the column density is deduced from optically thin lines of CH$_3^{18}$OH) yields a CD$_3$OD/CH$_3$OH ratio as high as $\sim$0.02%

answer_key.quantity: Implied D/H ratio from CD3OD upper limit

evidence.quote: If all D/H substitutions would be considered equally probable, this in turn would imply a D/H ratio of about 12%

score_reason: The spectroscopic dataset, Hamiltonian parameters, and calculated line list/partition function are fully published at CDS/CDMS, and the ALMA PILS data are public, though a few LTE modeling parameters (exact offset coordinates, source size) require consulting earlier PILS papers.
rediscovery_reason: Both the CD3OD spectroscopic catalog (at CDS/CDMS) and the ALMA PILS dataset (2013.1.00278.S) are public, and the main astronomical result is a numeric upper limit on the column density derived from standard LTE synthetic spectra.
